_comment: params.json + the first real fits (python -m measure holdout; see CLAUDE.md Fidelity log). Every value is an UNMEASURED PLACEHOLDER until provenance says otherwise. Units: meters, seconds, kilograms, radians. Rink origin is center ice; +x points at net 1 (team 0 attacks +x).

gravity.note: game gravity may not be real-world

rink_width.note: MEASURED SHAPE: inner board width, mean of 3 clips (sd 0.044 m); length/width = 1.5708; absolute scale UNMEASURED (meters assume the placeholder rink_length 60 m); the ratio to rink_length is measured

rink_corner_radius.note: MEASURED SHAPE: from the rounded outline's area deficit, mean of 3 clips (sd 0.033 m); absolute scale UNMEASURED (meters assume the placeholder rink_length 60 m); the ratio to rink_length is measured

board_restitution.note: FITTED on real wall-bounce segments (puck_05, puck_08, puck_09, wall_04, wall_07, wall_09), path-only objective (rebound geometry), ice params fixed from the glide fit; held out by clip: train justhittin -> held-out justpuckph score 283.85 -> 12.81; train justpuckph -> held-out justhittin score 56.10 -> 2.30. Positions/speeds at the PLACEHOLDER meter scale; ratio, scale-free.

board_friction.note: FITTED on real wall-bounce segments (puck_05, puck_08, puck_09, wall_04, wall_07, wall_09), path-only objective (rebound geometry), ice params fixed from the glide fit; held out by clip: train justhittin -> held-out justpuckph score 283.85 -> 12.81; train justpuckph -> held-out justhittin score 56.10 -> 2.30. Positions/speeds at the PLACEHOLDER meter scale; ratio, scale-free.

net_x.note: MEASURED SHAPE: goal line |x| (net mouth), grey line nearest each net, painted ice markings, ice-plane scale, mean of 3 clips (sd 0.010 m); absolute scale UNMEASURED (meters assume the placeholder rink_length 60 m); the ratio to rink_length is measured

net_width.note: MEASURED SHAPE: net roof width seen from above, corrected for roof-height parallax (k = 0.0844, from the off-center clip); camera-centered clips; absolute scale UNMEASURED (meters assume the placeholder rink_length 60 m); the ratio to rink_length is measured

net_depth.note: MEASURED SHAPE: goal line to the parallax-corrected back of the roof, assuming a flat roof (uncorrected roof outline gives 4.34 m); absolute scale UNMEASURED (meters assume the placeholder rink_length 60 m); the ratio to rink_length is measured

net_height.note: puck above this passes over the net frame

ice_friction_decel.note: FITTED on real glide segments (puck_01, puck_02, puck_03, puck_04, puck_06, puck_07, puck_10, wall_01, wall_02, wall_03, wall_05, wall_06, wall_08, wall_10, wall_11), path objective; held out by clip: train justhittin -> held-out justpuckph score 283.85 -> 12.81; train justpuckph -> held-out justhittin score 56.10 -> 2.30. Positions/speeds at the PLACEHOLDER meter scale; fitted ~0 in both hold-out directions, so unit-free in practice.

ice_linear_drag.note: FITTED on real glide segments (puck_01, puck_02, puck_03, puck_04, puck_06, puck_07, puck_10, wall_01, wall_02, wall_03, wall_05, wall_06, wall_08, wall_10, wall_11), path objective; held out by clip: train justhittin -> held-out justpuckph score 283.85 -> 12.81; train justpuckph -> held-out justhittin score 56.10 -> 2.30. Positions/speeds at the PLACEHOLDER meter scale; 1/s, scale-free.

player_height.note: puck above this passes over the body

player_ice_drag.note: coasting deceleration with no move input

stick_inner.note: distance from player center where the collidable stick starts

stick_length.note: distance from player center to stick tip

stick_mass.note: rod pivoting at player center, I = m L^2 / 3

stick_z_min.note: stick hits puck only when z is inside [min, max]

max_puck_speed_air.note: horizontal cap for shots that leave the ice

dash_speed.note: PLACEHOLDER LOGIC: velocity impulse on dash press

dash_duration.note: window during which stick hits count as dash shots

lift_vz_factor.note: PLACEHOLDER LOGIC: vz = factor * horizontal speed on a lifted hit

chip_max_speed.note: PLACEHOLDER LOGIC: dash + lift hit is capped to this (low-speed chip)

blue_line_x.note: DISPLAY ONLY. MEASURED SHAPE: |x| of the inner grey lines, painted ice markings, ice-plane scale, mean of 3 clips (sd 0.015 m); absolute scale UNMEASURED (meters assume the placeholder rink_length 60 m); the ratio to rink_length is measured

faceoff_x.note: DISPLAY ONLY. MEASURED SHAPE: |x| of the end-zone faceoff dots, painted ice markings, ice-plane scale, mean of 3 clips (sd 0.013 m); absolute scale UNMEASURED (meters assume the placeholder rink_length 60 m); the ratio to rink_length is measured

faceoff_y.note: DISPLAY ONLY. MEASURED SHAPE: |y| of the end-zone faceoff dots, painted ice markings, ice-plane scale, mean of 3 clips (sd 0.011 m); absolute scale UNMEASURED (meters assume the placeholder rink_length 60 m); the ratio to rink_length is measured

faceoff_circle_radius.note: DISPLAY ONLY. MEASURED SHAPE: faceoff circle radius (ellipse fits), painted ice markings, ice-plane scale, mean of 3 clips (sd 0.003 m); absolute scale UNMEASURED (meters assume the placeholder rink_length 60 m); the ratio to rink_length is measured

speed_display_scale.note: DISPLAY ONLY: real-game m/s per sim m/s, for the mph/kph readout

match_length_s.note: MATCH RULE (Ian): regulation clock, counts down in the playing phase only

mercy_lead.note: MATCH RULE (Ian): the match ends as soon as a team leads by this many goals (interpretation: a lead, not a total); <= 0 disables

countdown_s.note: MATCH RULE, invented: frozen countdown before play at the start and after each goal

goal_pause_s.note: MATCH RULE, invented: frozen pause after a goal before the reset

player_spawn_x.note: MATCH RULE, invented: |x| of the match spawn points (team 0 at -x, team 1 at +x), facing center
